svg.title: From County Inventory to Realized Cash
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-certificate-to-realized-cash; chart type: process_flow; title: From County Inventory to Realized Cash; subtitle: Five operating steps keep invested principal separate from earnings.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Applies to statutory certificates and separately classified redeemable deeds. County procedures control execution. The canonical time to first deal is 3–10 months; completing research or registering for an auction does not establish an earned return.; caption: Track each parcel from original county record through bank settlement. Returned principal replenishes investment capital; only realized interest, penalties, and disposition gains enter the revenue scorecard.; stages: label: Source official inventory; value: County records before auction marketing; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Download the county treasurer or tax collector sale file, preserve its publication date, and cross-check parcel identifiers against assessor GIS and recorder records. Record whether the asset is a certificate or a redeemable deed.; label: Underwrite parcel and procedure; value: Title, access, value, and statutory clock; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Have the title contractor review recorded interests, access, parcel usability, and competing taxes. Local counsel maps redemption and enforcement requirements; PACER checks support bankruptcy review under 11 U.S.C. section 362.; label: Price and acquire; value: Bid ceiling includes trapped-cash exposure; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Model the actual interest-bearing base, auction premium, fees, subsequent taxes, and collection delay. Apply the auction's bid-down or premium rules rather than bidding from a headline statutory rate.; label: Service and reconcile; value: Track redemption without counting accruals; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Use a SQLite parcel register and scheduled calendar alerts for receipts, statutory dates, and subsequent tax decisions. Match county statements to bank activity and flag overdue events for human review.; label: Redeem or resolve; value: Separate principal, earnings, costs, and surplus; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Post returned principal to the investment ledger and realized earnings to revenue. Route nonredemption through counsel-led enforcement or loss resolution; a property transfer alone is not a realized disposition gain, and restricted surplus is not operator revenue.

text.title: Post returned principal to the investment ledger and realized earnings to revenue. Route nonredemption through counsel-led enforcement or loss resolution; a property transfer alone is not a realized disposition gain, and restricted surplus is not operator revenue.

Assumptions: Applies to statutory certificates and separately classified redeemable deeds. County procedures control execution. The canonical time to first deal is 3–10 months; completing research or registering for an auction does not establish an earned return.
